A hollow in the old oak. A dry hollow, with a thick layer of dry leaves and a few twigs. I sit in it, and the ivy grows down the trunk. The ivy is my ladder.

A hollow in the old oak. The bark is thick and the inside is dry. I have a roost in the hollow, and a separate one in the ivy. I go between them at dusk.

A hollow in the old oak at the edge of the wood. It is deep, and the bark is thick, so the wind does not go through it. I have been here since I was a fledgling, and I have raised my own young here. My home is the hollow in the old oak at the edge of the wood. I have lived there for many years, and it is safe. The oak is old and strong, and the hollow is deep. My home is the hollow in the old oak by the brook. I made it with my mate, and we have raised two broods. The oak is old, and the hollow is deep and dry. I sleep there, and I keep my eggs there. A hollow in the old oak. The bark is split and the wood is soft, so I can hear the owlets from the inside. I have been there all my life, and the ivy and ivy berries grow thick. I do not go far from it, not even to the brook, and I do not go to the meadow. I stay in the oak.

I have a hollow in the old oak at the edge of the wood. The bark is rough and the roots are deep. I have nested there for many years, and the young have come and gone. My home is the hollow in the old oak by the brook. It is dry and deep enough to keep me warm. I have lived there for many years, and it is where I have raised my young. I do not need to speak of it, for it is all I know. I sit there every night, and the wind sings through the leaves. Hoo... hoo-hoo-hooo.

I have a hollow in the old oak at the edge of the wood. The oak is hollow inside, and I have made it my own. I have a mate, and we have two young. The hollow is my home, and I do not leave it often. I call from it, and I watch from it. It is my place, and I am content there.

A hollow in the old oak at the edge of the wood. The bark is rough, the leaves fall in the autumn. I have lived here for many years, and the hollow is warm in the winter, cool in the summer. My home is the hollow in the old oak by the brook. It is deep and dry, and I have been there all my life. The oak is a wide tree, and the hollow is wide too. I live in the hollow of the old oak by the brook. The bark is thick and the leaves are soft. I have a nest of dry leaves and feathers. I sit in the hollow when it is dark and the wind is still. I live in the hollow of an old oak by the brook. The hollow is deep and dark, and I have made a nest of dry leaves and moss. I sleep there in the night, and I watch the meadow from the branch above. The brook is my boundary, and I do not go beyond it. The hollow is my home, and I am content there.

My home is the hollow in the old oak by the brook. It is dry and warm, and the ivy grows thick on the outside. I have lived there since I was a fledgling, and the ivy is thick with my scent now.
